payload.answer: The reports-worker deployment was unschedulable because its pod template required an invalid nodeSelector (disk=nvme) and lacked the dedicated=reports:NoSchedule toleration required by the intended node (node1). The deployment was patched to target nodeSelector storage=nvme and include the narrow toleration for dedicated=reports:NoSchedule. The replacement pod reports-worker-79bbd64df8-hsfg9 was successfully scheduled onto node1 and is Running and Ready.
